record.oneLiner: A tyrannosaurid apex predator of latest-Cretaceous Alberta.
record.description: Albertosaurus was a large tyrannosaurid predator of northwestern North America, with short arms, two-fingered hands and a massive head full of sharp teeth. Smaller than its famous relative Tyrannosaurus, it may still have been the apex predator of its ecosystem.

notableFacts.text: Had a strong sense of smell, powerful binocular vision and a bone-crushing bite.
A bonebed of many individuals hints it may have lived in groups.
